The remaining observation — the controller spec only tests ancestry — is a generic test-coverage nit, not decision-relevant.

judged_text: The only test for Admin::EmbeddingController asserts class ancestry and never exercises show/update, so the fact that the update action (embedding_controller.rb lines 12-14) never applies any params and is a no-op that just re-serializes the fetched model goes completely unverified. The embedding settings form in the admin UI silently discards all user edits while the suite stays green; anyone changing embedding settings gets no persistence and no test failure.

adjudication.rationale: The diff does add Admin::EmbeddingController#update that simply re-serializes the fetched OpenStruct and applies no params (app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb), and its spec only checks ancestry. However, the claim that an “embedding settings form” discards user edits is not supported by the shown UI: admin/templates/embedding.hbs only lists embeddable_hosts and provides an add button; edits are persisted per-host via EmbeddableHost#save to /admin/embeddable_hosts (admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6 + Admin::EmbeddableHostsController). There is no form or save action wired to embedding.update in the template, so the asserted broken persistence cannot be verified from the diff.
